content.text: {"Id":"PLAN-LLMSTRATEGY-001","Title":"Implement QuadBrain per-segment LLM strategy pattern","Section":"QuadBrain","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["Replace the string-only IBrainSlotChatClient hop (OpenAI vs OpenAICompatible HTTP only) with a strategy pattern so each QuadBrain segment (Creativity, Logic, CuriosityEngine, ArbiterOfTruth) can be backed by a different LLM provider strategy, including future in-process engines. The strategy contract must be richer than CompleteAsync(slot, input, temperature) -\u003E string so a turn can share orchestration context (original input, committed role evidence, session/turn/transaction ids) by reference. HTTP strategies may still flatten that to chat messages. Do not merge a third-party agent/tool stack into QuadBrain. Capture FR/TR/TEST and a BDPv4 plan before implementation. Successor: PLAN-SHARPMIND-001."],"TechnicalDetails":null,"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":null,"TechnicalRequirements":null,"IdempotencyKey":null}
